tei:div.tei:p: 785)༄༅/ gnam chos thugs gter gyi gtum mo'i khrid bde drod rang 'bar gyi dmigs rim ngag 'don bya tshul rig 'dzin zhal lung bzhugs/ 786)rnam kun mchog ldan mi 'gyur rdo rje can// lhan skyes bde chen karma chags med dang*// zung 'jug kha sbyor kun bzang shes rab mchog dbyer med ngag gi dbang po gtsug tu mdzes/ rten gyi gang zag dbang thob dam tshig ldan pas/ rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag bcang gi sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyangs mthar phyin/ bum dbang gi lam spyan ras gzigs lta bu'i bskyed rim yul gsum gyad du gyur pas/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi mtshan rtog zlum pa'i phyir dbang gong ma'i lam 'dir 'jug par bya ste/ 'di la'ang gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la'ang*/ thun dang thun mtshams dbye nas thun gyi sngon 'gro/ lus gnad/ ngag gnad/ sems gnad/ bla ma la gsol 787)'debs rnams song nas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i blo sbyong gcig dril gyi ngag 'don ni/ dal 'byor lus 'di shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bu don sgrub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma sgrub na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur// srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs// 'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du gyur 'gyogs 'gro// dus kyi bsnyen nas rgyal po 'gro gyur na// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshais rjes mi 'brang*// skyes bu dag ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang*// las ni 788)grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// srid sred ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'phang lo 'khor ba bzhin// srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar// 'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de// srid las byung ba 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin/

zhes dang*/ thar pa'i gru gzings las/ kye ma 'khor ba mtha' med= sogs nas/ thar bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes brjod de blo sbyang*/ de nas ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ snyam du sems bskyed/ khyad par sngon 'gro gcig dril thun min lugs ni/ khrid gzhung las/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug khru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa'i steng du/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'igu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal 789)gcig spyan gsum khro zhing 'dzum pa dbu skra thor tshugs rin po che'i prog zhu dar gyis cod pan bcings ba/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol thabs su yum la 'khyud pa/ sku gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol nas rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum man+dha ra ba bye ru'i mdog can/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon thod sa bdud rtsis gang ba stob pa/ bcu drug laun pa'i na tshod/ bde ba'i nyams kyi yab dang zhal sbyor ba/ yab yum gnyis ka ye shes kyi me dpung 'u ru ru 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum/ khyad par yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad rang dbang med par spyan drangs nas/ bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon te/ yab yum gyi sku la mtsho la char pa babs pa ltar thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bzhugs par gyur/ skyabs 'gro ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/

sogs ma nam bzhi bskor gyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ 790)ngag 'don ye shes phung po las/ na mo/ rtsa khams dag pa rgyal brgya mtsho'i tshogs// rlung khams dag pa mdo sngags dam pa'i chos// thig le dag pa rtsa gsum lha tshogs la// 'khor 'das dag pa'i ngang nas skyabs su mchi/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ma ci nus bsags/ sems bskyed ni// ma gyur 'gro drug don dam thig le che/ ma rtogs rang lus rtsa rlung sangs rgyas su// ma shes 'gro rnams bsgral phyir bdag gis 'dir/ ma bcos ye grol chen por sems bskyed do/ ces lan gsum/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ gling bzhi longs spyod phyi yi maṇ+ḍal 'bul// rtsa rlung rnam dag nang gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ ting gsal mtha' bral gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul// bed drod rang 'bar dbyings rig dngos grub stsol/ zhes pa dang*/ sa gzhi spos chu ma grangs gsog lus sbyin ni/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir// phangs med par btang bar bya/ sdig pa bshags pa ni/ brkyangs phyag 'tshal bzhin du/ zhi khro bshags chung lta bu btang na/ bcom ldan 'das= phyogs bcu= nas/

yig brgya dang sbrel te phyag brgya/ ho/ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs= nas/ sgo gsum bag med dam nyams bshags/ zhes dang*/ lus kyi 791)las ni rnam pa gsum/ sogs dang*/ bdag sogs 'gro ba thog ma med pa nas// nyon mongs sdig ltung dpag tu med bsags bas// gnong 'gyod chen pos lhag ma med par bshags// tshangs par stsal nas sgrib pa med par mdzod// yid kyi dam nyams lta bas= sogs nas/ gnyis med grol/ bar ro/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag 'khrul med dbyings kyi pho brang na// kun bzang 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid snying rje 'gro 'dul pho brang na// byams mgon spyan ras gzigs la= bar chad kun 'dul thugs rje'i pho brang na// 'chi med pad+ma rgyal por= bde stong dga' bzhi'i dpal bskyed pho brang na// mtsho rgyal la sogs yum la= bde drod me dpung 'bar ba'i pho brang na/ khro rgyal ro za nyid la= sku gsum klong yangs bde chen pho brang na// gcig chog bla ma rje la= rlung sems snang ba dag pa'i pho brang na// mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes dang*/ sku gsum gsol 'debs dang*/ gter ma'i gsol 'debs gang rung dang*/ badz+ra gu ru ci nus bsgrang*/ de nas dbang len pa'i don du yan lag bdun pa ni/ sku gsum klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo// lus dang longs spyod dge 792)tshogs mchod pa 'bul// nyes ltung sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams mthol zhing bshags// 'khor 'das dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang*// gsang sngags zab lam chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol// dge rnams 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// bdag sogs rtsa rlung thig le las su rung*// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro kun mngon byang mchog la 'god par shog dbang len pa ni/ khrid gzhung las/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgra/

ha ha si si zhes pa'i sgras yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs te pho rigs thams cad yab dang*/ mo rigs thams yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku yi dbyibs brgyud pas 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi byang sems dkar dmar du gyur pa/ sbyor 'tshams nas babs te/ rang ni tshangs bug nas zhugs pas/ spyi bo gang bas bum dbang*/ mgrin pa gang bas gsang dbang*/ snying kha gang bas shes rab ye shes/ rkang mthil yan gang bas dbang bzhi pa thob/ lhag ma gyen du 'khyil bas/ bla ma yab yum gzi brjid cher 'bar te 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur te/ byang sems ba spu'i 793)bu ga nas phrom mer byung ba la gser gyi rdo rje phyed pa rer gyur/ ma dag pa'i rtsa thig rlung gsum dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum du byin gyis brlabs par sgom/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog zhes sogs kyis dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo ba yan la zhag gsum du bsgom zhing thun re re'i dmigs pa lan nyer gcig re las mi nyung ba dgos par gsungs/ de la zhag gsum bya/ chos thun dang po'o/ ༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gsang dbang gi lam rtsa rlung bsgom pa dang*/ sher dbang gi lam thig le bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po la dmigs thun bdun las/ dang po ni/ thun 'go rnams su bla ma'i rnal 'byor gong ltar gnad smin rjes su/ lus gnad yang*/ rkang pa rdor skyil gyis bde drod skyed/ lag gnyis mnyam bzhag dang gru mo rgyangs pas g.yo byed kyi bde drod myur du skye/ rgal tshig bsrang*/ mgrin pa bkugs/ lce yar rkan la sbyar bas rlung gnad du tshud/ lus cha cha nas bsgrim pas steng 'og gi rlung thams cad chun cing bde drod skye/ mig sna rtse la gtad pas rig pa dwangs shing dmigs pa gsal ba dang*/

thabs lam gyi lus gnad tha gu dbyug pas sgrim pa lta bu'i grim cha chags pa gal che/ dmigs gnad ni/ gter gzhung las/ 794) rang nyid khro bo ro za ni: sku mdog dmar po zhi ma khro: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: phyag gnyis g.yas pas snying zhags dang: g.yon pas se gol gtog par byed: lte ba'i thad du dbu ma ni: phyi ni dkar la nang ni dmar: sngo sangs snyug rgod 'bring po tsam: de yi dbus su ram̐ yig las: skyed pa'i me ni sran ma tsam: 'od ni phra'u 'bar ba zhig: de ru bsam la rlung bzung bas: rlung gi drod de cung bskyed bsam: zhes gsungs pa'i don/ de la rigs ldan gyi gzhi bzung ba phyi lus kyi stong ra ni/ stod pa'i ngang las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po khro bor bzhengs pa spang bya mi mthun phyogs thams cad 'joms shig za bar byed pa/ sku mdog pad+ma ra ga'am bye ru lta bu la nyi ma'i snying po ltar 'od 'bar ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal cung zad gdangs pa bzhad pa'i tshul gyis zhi ma khro/ zhabs gnyis ye shes 'bebs pa'i cha lugs bzhengs pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pas mnyen lcug ldem pa/ phyag gnyis g.yas snang srid kyi bcud dang snying po len pa'i brdar snying dang*/ don gyi 'bras bu myur du len pa'i brdar don yod pa'i zhags pa dmar po gnyis 795)'phyar thabs su bsnams shing*/ g.yon bag med pa'i gnyid las bslang nas skad cig re rer yang*/ sa lam gong du 'phel ba'i brdar se gol gtog par byed pa/ sku gcer bu la dur khrod kyi chas sogs khro bo'i nyams du ma dang ldan zhing*/ bar chad kyi gegs dpung bsreg pa'i brdar/ rang 'od bde drod kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de yang zhal gcig ni chos sku nyag gcig phyag gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab/ zhabs gnyis ni bden pa gnyis/ spyan gsum ni sku gsum/ mche ba bzhi ni bdud bzhi bcom pa/ sku mdog dmar ba ni 'gro la thugs rjes chags pa/

'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pas pad gdan/ 'gro ba'i mun pa sel bas nyi gdan/ stobs bcu rdzogs pas dpal chas bcu/ tshogs brgyad dag pas ngur khrod chas brgyad la sogs pa yin par brda don shes par byas pas/ bskyed rim gyi gol sa chod/ sku'i phyi yi yas rim dang mas rim nas legs par gsal gdab nas mthar sku spyi la sems bzung*/ de nas sku yi nang sen mo'i rtse tshun chad stong pa phru ma phus btab 796)pa lta bur bsgom/ phyi dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu lha'i sku lam me ba la/ nang stong seng nge ba la rig pa gtad pa phyi lus kyi stong ra zhes bya'o/ de nas dpag bsam shing 'dzugs pa nang rtsa'i stong ra ni/ de ltar rang nyid yi dam lha'i skur gsal ba'i sku yi nang lte ba'i thad du/ a wa dhu ti'am/ mchog gi dbu ma de nyid/ bde ba mtshon pa'i phyir phyi dkar ba/ gsal ba mtshon pa'i phyir nang dmar ba/ mi rtog pa chos sku mtshon pa'i phyir nang stong pa sngo sang nge ba/ byang chub kyi lam mtshon pa'i phyir drang ba/ che chung snyug rgod 'bring po tsam pa/ shog gu'i sbu gu lta bu/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ta le bar bsgom pa ni nang rtsa'i stong ra'o/ de nas chu zla'i gar bsgyur ba gsang ba sems kyi stong ra bsgom pa ni/ de'i dbus su yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo me'i lha mo gos dkar mo'i ngo bo raṃ yig dmar po sran chung tsam/ de las bskyed pa'i me ni sran ma tsam/ kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba lcags sreg lta bu zhig bsgom pa'o/ rlung g.yon dang g.yas dang gnyis ka nas zhi drag snyoms gsum gyi rlung ro legs par lhag ma ma lus par bus te 797)tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sna bug gnyis dang ba spu'i khung nas sang gis thon par dmigs/ de nas/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil dkrung bca'// lag g.yon khu tshur pus steng sbubs// g.yas pa las bcar sdig mdzub brkyangs// bskum pa'i zhor la sna bug g.yas// bkag nas rlung ro g.yon phyogs su// pho mo ma ning gsum gsum bud// de nas lag g.yas pus steng sbubs// g.yon pa bkag la g.yas su gsum// de nas lag gnyis khu tshur bcang*// pus steng sbubs la mnyam du gsum// de ni rlung ro dgu phrug go

de nas rlung dal la ring bar rngubs te/ sna'i thad sor bcu gnyis pa'i nam mkha' nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rlung kha dog lnga 'od kyi stong skud ltar byung nas sna bug nas zhugs/ lte ba'i 'og dbu ma'i nang du yar zhugs pas/ me la sbud pa rgyab pa ltar me'i thig le de 798)las/ 'od ky-i rang bzhin dngos por ma grub pa'i me lce phra'u zangs ma'i mo khab tsam zhig sor lnga'i tshad tsam du 'bar ba/ de yang skad cig kyang mi sdod par rtse mo khyug khyug g.yo ba la sems gtad nas bsgom mo/ de yang me yi thig le de'i rtsa ba brtan pa/ kha dog shin ru dmar ba/ reg bya shin tu tsha ba/ me'i rtse shin tu phra zhing rno ba/ mi sdod par 'khyug par bsgom pa rnams gal che ste/ sor snga'i tshad ni 'byung ba lnga'i me dang lha mo lnga dang mkha' 'gro lnga sogs mtshon cing*/ gtum mo'i rang tshad sor lnga yin par bshad pas so/ dbu ma yang ring thung de tsam du bsgom par bya'o/ 'di'i tshe rlung sna bug g.yon dang*/ gnyis ka nas rgyu dus bzung*/ g.yas nas rgyu dus mi bzung*/ dge ba'i rtog pa skye dus bzung*/ mi ge ba skye dus phyir btang*/ 'bud dus lhag med du btang*/ rngub dus dal bar rngub/ rlung lte 'og tu mnan la/ gsus pa ther rgya/ sked pa nyag rgya/ 'og rlung sdom/ lus gnad bsrang*/ khyad par rgal tshig bsrang*/ du ba dang thal tshub yod dus mi bzung*/ lto 'brang ltog ran par bzung bas/ thal mo pus mo gnyis dang dpral bar reg nas se gol byas pa'i yun brgya rtsa brgyad bar du nang la bzung ba bum chen/ don gnyis la bum 'bring*/ 799)so drug la bum chung du bzhed/ rlung rngub dus lcags kyu bzhin 'gugs pa ni sgra med par dal bus rngub/ bum pa bzhin dgang ba ni lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung mthen/ rgya mdud bzhin sdom pa ni/ mi thub la khad du rngub chung bya/ mchan rdeb/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song ba'am/

dbu ma'i nang du thim par bsam/ mda' ltar 'phang ba ni/ sna bug gnyis nas dang po dang*/ mjug tu shed chung*/ bar du shugs che bar sang gis 'bud pa'o/ 'khrul 'khor gyi tshe re re ma rdzogs bar rlung mi gtong*/ yan lag lnga sbyang ni/ lag gnyis lus kyi sta zur shad// 'og nas gzhal nas mdun du brkyangs// nu steng khu tshur rtsibs logs su// gru mo brdab pa sbrags te gsum// de nas lag g.yas lus la gcar// mdun du brkyang la g.yon pas ni// mnyen bskor byas la lag g.yas kyis// steng dang 'og tu bshad pa gsum/ 800)/de bzhin g.yon pa la'ang gsum// mdun du lag gnyis mnyam por brkyang*// thal mo gsum phur thal mo bsnol// rna g.yas mdun rgyab lan gsum mnye// g.yon pa la'ang de bzhin bya// ngo dang mgo bo gsum gsum 'phur// de nas thal mo ro stod kyis// mdun rgyab res mos gsum gsum 'phur// de bzhin smad kyang gsum gsum 'phur// 'bebs chung mchan brdab rkang g.yas brkyangs// thal mos mnyen bskor lan gsum bshad// 'bebs chung g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 801)sbrags// gong bzhin lan gsum bshad par bya// 'bebs chung gsum brgyab ha sprugs kyis// 'bebs chung gcig dang mnyam por bya// dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur= sogs kyi bsngo smon dang*/ spyod lam kun tu rtsa ba'i mngon rtogs kyi lam khyer bya ba ni/ na mo:dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa: khro bo ro za sku mdog mthing: zhal gcig dang ni phyag bzhi pa: dang po gnyis ni thal mo sbyar: spyan ras gzigs kyi rtags su shes: de 'og gnyis ni thal mo rdeb: byad la sogs pa bzlog pa'i tshul: khro bo'i chas rnams yongs su rdzogs:

pad nyi byad steng zhabs bsgrad do: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ gi mthar: sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las: 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yi: rtsa gsum lha tshogs thams cad mchod: 802)kun kyang khro bo ro za'i skur: gyur nas char bzhin bdag la thim: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob: bde drod me ltar 'bar ba dang: sems nyid chos sku rjen par rtogs: oṃ ā hūm̐ lo ke shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: rtsa sngags brgya tsam bzla/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan khro bo'i rgyal po ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor los bsgyur// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba po/ khro ba'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod cing ma ṇi'i dbyangs kyis grol/ thun mtshams kun tu gnyid dang bza' btung dus ma gtogs rtse gcig tu gong gi dmigs pa bzung*/ drod skye rim bzhin gos je srab la btang*/ nyal kha dang rgyun par rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ du bsgom/ 'gro 'dug sogs dus bar rlung bzung dgos pas/ 'og sgo bsdom/ gsus pa ther bya/ yang na lte ba'i raṃ la sems gtad/ nang snga bar bum chen lan re ma chags na tshe'i bar chad sel/ skabs rnams su rdor sems sgom bzlas bya/ grib la 'dzem/ zas sngo rigs/ sgog pa/ a rag g.yer ma/ go snyod/ lga/ la phug chang skyur/ sha mar rul ba/ 'o rul/ yos/ nya phag dom dred/ rta drel sogs kyi sha dang*/ tsha dro ches pa sogs/ drod can gyi zas rnams 'dzem/ gos sha gos/ ko stan 803)rnams mi spyad/ lus sha rjen mi bya/ spyod lam 'chong rgyug sogs drag las/ nyin par gnyid/ ha cang 'grang che ba/ me nyi la bsdod pa/ khams thig le nyams pa rnams bsrung*/ nub mo srung 'khor dang*/ rgyun du byams snying rje'i gtong len rnams la bslab par bya'o/ de rnams khrid gzhung du gsal yang lag len thebs phyir ro/ chos thun gnyis pa la zhag gsum mo/

༈ 'di man gyi dmigs thun rnams la/ thun 'gor bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas brtsams/ rang rang la ma thug bar gyi snga ma rnams dang 'khrul 'khor bcas sngon du btang dgos shing*/ lus gnad me thab drug chings/ sgom thag gi gcun la/ dmigs rkang gnyis pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ de nas raṃ las raṃ gcig chad// me lce de yi rtse ru phyin: dbu ma snying khar slebs par bsam: rlung bzung rlung gis ram̐ la brgyab: de las me 'bar nas 'bru ni: ring shos tsam gyi me 'bar bas: drod ni de las rab che bsam: zhes gsungs pa'i don/ phyi lha'i stong ra/ nang rtsa'i stong ra rtsa dbu ma dang*/ de'i nang du me'i thig le ram̐ yig me 'bar ba dang bcas pa gsal btab/ de nas lte ba'i ram̐ yig de las ram̐ yig dmar po shin tu tsha 804)ba'i reg bya can zhig chad de/ me lce de'i rtse ru phyin nas bsdad/ rtsa dbu ma yang yar ring nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo cung zad brgal tsam du slebs par bsgom/ de nas rlung bzung bas rlung lte 'og nas dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ lte ba'i ram̐ dang snying kha'i raṃ gnyis ka la brgyab pas/ dmar 'ur gyis de la me 'bar te/ phra sbom nas 'bru ring shos tsam zheng du dang*/ dkyus su dbu ma dang ring thung mnyam par 'bar bas/ de'i tsha ngad shin tu che bas drod ni lus thams cad la sngon las kyang rab tu che bar bsam/ de yang rlung rngubs tshe rlung brgyabs pas me 'bar bar bsgom pa dang*/ rlung bskang bzung tshe me lce nyid la sems bzung ba dang*/ rlung gzhil ba'i tshe yang me lce yod tshun la/ lte ba'i raṃ yig la sems bzung ste dbu ma'i nang kho na la sems yun ring du zin pas drod skye ba'i gnad yin/ lag gnyis pus mo g.yas la 'jus na pho ba g.yas skor g.yon skor gsum/ pus mo g.yon la de bzhin gsum/ de nas drag rlung bzung*/ 'bebs chung*/ ha sprug bcas lan gsum rjes 'bebs cheb gcig gam/ 'bebs chung gsum/

rkang lag gi mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam nas rkang pa kha sbyar/ lag pas 805)lus thams chad 'phur ba rnams drod skye ba'i thabs yin/ gnyis pa 'khrul 'khor drug pa ni// rkang pa phyed pa'i skyil mo la// lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcang*// brla rtsa mnan la lus po bsrang*// rked pa g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor// de nas lus po g.yas phyogs su// gsum gcus bzhin kyang de phyogs ga gcu// de bzhin g.yon du lan gsum gcu// de nas mgrin pa rtsol med glod// g.yas dang g.yon du gsum gsum bskor// de nas ol sko brang la brdeg /mgo bo rgyab tu shugs kyis 'phongs// de ltar lan gsum byas rjes su// 'bebs chung gcig brgyab g.yas phyogs kyi// rkang lag mnyam brkyangs lan gsum brdeg /'bebs chung gcig dang g.yon pa'ang gsum// de nas 'bebs chung gsum brgyab pa// 'phur srubs bya ba 'di ltar ro// dang po gong bzhin thal mo mnye// mig ngo mgo bo gsum gsum 'phur/ 806)de nas lag gnyis gong bzhin bshad// de nas thal mos ro stod dang*// ro smad g.yas g.yon gsum gsum 'phur/ 'bebs chung rkang pa g.yas brkyangs shing*// gsum 'phur 'bebs chung rkang g.yon brkyang*// gong bzhin lan gsum bshad byas la// 'bebs dang bstun pa'i sprug gsum// brgyab ma mnyam du rlung ro ni// ha zhes drag tu brjod la btang*/ de nyid yang yang bskyar/ rjes rnams gong dang 'dra/ de la zhag gsum bya/ chos thun gsum pa'o/ ༈ dmigs rkang gsum pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ ram̐ las ram̐ 'phros me yi rtser: 'od dang bcas pas phyin par bsam: de nas rlung bzung rlung phog pas: me ni de las rab che 'bar: dbu ma mgrin pa'i gnas su sleb: me ni de las kyang che bar bsam: rlung bus phog pas dbu ma gang: zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rang nyid yi dam pad+ma he ru ka spyan ras gzigs ro zar gsal ba'i/ lte 'og nas snying kha'i stod bar du ye shes kyi rtsa dbu ma gtum mo'i mes gang ba/

me'i snying po lte ba dang snying khar ram̐ yig 807)dmar po res mtshan pa'am/ snying kha'i ram̐ las ram̐ dmar po gcig chad de/ snying kha'i me lce'i rtse mor bzhugs pa dang mnyam du dbu ma yang yar skyes te mgrin pa'i gong tsam du slebs/ rlung bzung bas lte 'og nas dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa'i 'og gi ram̐ la bus pas/ dbu ma mes gang*/ khyad par ram̐ gong ma las me cher 'bar/ mgrin pa'i dbu ma mes gang*/ de ltar lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa'i thad kyi dbu ma ye shes kyi mes gang bas/ lus kyi sked pa dang brang gi thad dang mgrin pa rnams su bde drod cher 'bar bar bsgom/ de yang lha'i sku rang gi lus tshad tsam bsgom pa'i tshe/ dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan snyug rgod 'bring po tsam bsgom/ lha sku je cher bsgom ste mkhar tsam la dbu ma ka ba tsam/ sku ri tsam dang ri rab tsam dang nam mkha' khyab pa la'ang de las dpags te che bar bsgom pa dang sa/ res je chung du bsgom ste sku yungs 'bru tsam la dbu ma yang skra rtse brgyar bshags pa'i tshad tsam du 'phra bar bsgom pa sogs rtsal byang ngo*/ de yang rlung bsgom tshe ba spu'i khung bu 808)thams cad khrol tshags ltar bsgom pa nas rlung bun bun 'gro bar bsam pas rlung khugs ring*/ yang skabs su gegs mi 'byung ba dang bar chad bsrung ba'i ched du rlung phyir dbyung ba dang mnyam du lte ba'i me'i 'od zer las grub pa'i khro bo ro za dmar po sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon te 'jig rten khyab nas gnod byed thams cad sprin nag rlung gis gtor ba ltar bskrad/ rlung tshur rngubs pa dang mnyam du ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas zhal phyir gzigs nas bar mtshams med par khrab lta bu bsgom par yang bya'o/ de nas 'khrul 'khor so bdun ni// rkang pa phyed pa'i skyil mo la// lag gnyis pus steng sa non byas// pho ba g.yas gsum g.yon gsum bskor// lag gnyis sor bsnol pus g.yas 'jus// gong bzhin pho ba g.yas g.yon bskor// lag gnyis yon 'jus gsum gsum bskor// rdo rje'i khu tshur sta zur brgyud// mgo la bskor nas g.yas phyogs su// rdo 'phen bzhin

809)du lan gsum 'phang*// de bzhin g.yon pa 'ang lan gsum 'phang*// lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur la// gzhu ( sran ? )'gengs bzhin g.yon phyogs su// gsum 'gengs gru mo rtsibs logs brdab// de bzhin g.yas phyogs gsum 'gengs bya// rdo rje khu tshur bcang bzhin la// lag g.yon g.yas pa'i nang nas ni// gsum bshad g.yon pa la'ang gsum// bar 'bebs gsum dang 'bebs chung gsum// rdzogs nas lan gsum sprugs byas la// rjes ma dang sbrags rlung ro ni// ha ring brjod cing btang bar bya/ de nyid yang yang bskyar de la zhag gsum mo/ chos thun bzhi pa'o/ ༈ dmigs thun bzhi pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ yang ni de la rlung phog pas: de la ram̐ ched me yi steng: 'od dang lhem lhem 'gul bar bsam: de nas rlung ni cher g.yos pas: dbu ma smin mtshams gnas su sleb: de las me ni rab che 'bar: 810)sna rtser phyin dang lte ba yan: dbu ma me yis khengs par bsam: zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rang lus khro bo'i sku stong gsal gyi dbus drang por lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar rtsa dbu ma ram̐ yig gsum dang bcas pa'i mes gang bar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ rlung bzung bas lte 'og nas dbu mar zhugs/ ram̐ yig gsum la bus pas/ mgrin pa'i ram̐ de las ram̐ gcig chad de me lce'i rtse der 'od 'bar ba dang bcas lhem lhem skad cig kyang mi sdod par 'gul bar dmigs/ yang rlung bzung zhing sngar ltar dbu ma'i nang nas yar phog pas/ dbu ma yang yar ring nas smin mtshams kyi thad sor sleb/ yang rlung bzung bas/ ram̐ las me 'bar re/ dbu ma'i yar sne'i rtse smin 'tshams su sleb pa man chad/ lte ba yan chad lcags sbubs me lces khengs pa ltar dbu ma mes khengs par bsam/ de ltar dbu ma mes gang bas lus thams cad shugs kyi bde drod 'bar bar dmigs/ skabs su gegs sel rigs kyang blo la yod pa gces pas/ de la gegs sel mang na yang*/ stod nad gyen la 'don pa/

smad nad thur du dbab pa/ bar nad thad kar gseng ba gsum du 'dus/ 811)de yang blo mi bde ba snying rlung*/ rlung 'thums te brgyal lam brgyal la khad pa/ rig pa rnal du mi gnas pa/ stod 'tshangs ba/ brgyang ba/ rlung gi stod gzer ba rnams la/ phyed skyil bcas lag pas dpus mo bkab/ mgrin pa cung tsam dgye bar byas la/ nam mkhar yi ge ha ljang khu gcig bsgoms/ hā zhes ring por brjod pas rang gi snying nang nas ha ljang khu gcig las/ ha ljang khu bar ma chad par 'phros pas kha nas thon te nam mkha'i lha la sib sib thim par bsgom/ lag pa g.yas gdengs nas pus steng bzhag ha zhes brjod/ g.yon ha ring*/ g.yas ha ring gsum dang*/ bar pa lag mig thad tsam gdengs ste ha gsum/ tha ma 'gyogs par gsum/ rjes ha mang po dang*/ dbugs nang du bsdu ba dang rkang lag bsdu na dkrol ba dang ha ha zhes brjod/ mthar snying nang gi rlung ro ngan pa thams cad ha'i rang bzhin du zad par bsam pas sel lo/ de nas lag so sor khu tshur gung mo sgrengs pa pus steng bsrong la/ yang snying ga dang lus stod khog par drod chen po skye/ kha rlangs kyang tsha/ dbugs thung la rgod/ lag pa'i rtsa yang grims la mgyogs pa tshad pa skyes pa 812)'dra na me rlung stobs che ba yin pas/ lus bsrangs la so bsgrigs pa'i bar nas chu rlung grang si ri ri rngubs la khog tu bzung*/ snying gi nang du yi ge bam̐ dkar po shin tu grang ba 'khyag pa lta bu las/ ga bur gyi rang bzhin chu 'khyag si li li babs pas byang khog gang*/ don snod thams cad bshal nas 'og sgo nas phyir thon par bsgom/ ngag tu sib zhes lus sprugs lan gsum/ zas ma zhu bas pho ba gzer ba la/ rlung drag tu bzung la pho bar gtum mo'i mes gang bar bsam la drag rlung bzung*/ lag gnyis lus bcar thal mo bkan te brkyang la lag gnyis sol bsnol pus g.yas bzung pho bskor g.yas gsum g.yon gsum phus g.yas gdab/ de bzhin g.yon la'ang gsum/

yang na bar rlung cung zad bzung nas lus gan rkyal du hrengs nyal byas te/ lag mthil me'i dkyil 'khor du bsam pas pho ba g.yas skor g.yon skor du bshad kyis lan mang du 'phur bas sel lo/ yan lag gi tshigs na ba la/ tshigs gang du na ba der bug pa gsum gsum yod par bsam la rlung thams cad dud pa'am rlangs pa ltar thob par bsgoms te/ bshul la sogs pa lus gar na sar yang de ltar 813)bsgoms shing rlung bzung la phur bas sel lo/ rkang pa phyed skyil gyi g.yas rgyab mar byas pa'i g.yas pa'i rkang sting dang g.yon pa'i mtheb mo gnyis thig drang por bya/ lag g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag snying gar bcas la/ yang snang ba za zi/ rig pa phya phyo/ rna ba ku zing*/ 'gro 'dod yang dzab dzab sdod mi zug pa ni rlung langs pa yin pas/ mdun du kā pa la rgya che bar bdud rtsi 'bri mar gyi khu ba ser ltem me bas gang ba la/ rang gis rkang mtheb sbu gu lta bus drangs te lus ser stem gyis gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas yungs 'bru tsam ser phrom me byung bar dmigs la/ 'jam rlung bzung snying gar lag mnyam bzhag bca' zhing*/ snying gi dkyil du gser gyi mchod rten shin tu ljid pa la sems bzung bas sel lo/ mkha' dbyings phyag rgya smin mtshams su mgo 'jug ldog te/ rang gi smin 'tshams thad kyi nang du chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ gdengs ka gyen bstan gyi zur gsum rna ba gnyis dang smin phrag tu gzug pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du mgrin pa'i nang du yod pa phyi nang dkar sing nge ba'i nang dbus su/ a 814)yig dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can las zag med bdud rtsi'i rgyun ngang khra la la babs pas/ lus thams cad gang*/ chag nyams sdig sgrib thams cad 'og gi sgo gnyis dang ba spu'i bu ga nas nag nu ru ru thon/ lus shel sgong ltar gyur par bsgoms shing ngag tu āḥbasgrang ngo*/ de yang tshad pa'i nad la bdud rtsi dkar po ga bur gyi rang bzhin grang si li li dang*/

grang ba'i nad yod na bdud rtsi dmar po zangs khu ltar tsha chi li li ba dang*/ rlung nad la bdud rtsi zhun mar bcud can ser na re ba dang*/ gdon la ngo bo bdud rtsi la rnam pa khro chu khol ma'i rnam par bsgom la/ nad dang sdig sgrib dri khu dud khu'i rnam pa dang*/ gdon ni 'bu srin gyi rnam par nag nyi li li bud par bsgom/ chos thun lnga pa'o/ zhag gsum mo/ dmigs thun lnga pa ni/ de nas rlung ni cher phog pas: dbu ma tshangs pa'i bu gar sleb: ram̐ las ram̐ 'phros me steng phyin: ( 'ong ni ) raṃ la rlung phog pas: smin mtshams phyin gyi dbu ma khengs: zhes pa'i don ni/ rang lus yi dam he ru ka dmar po dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu la/ nang stong pa 815)phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i dbus su/ lte 'og sor bzhi nas smin mtshams thad bar du dbu ma ka ba btsugs pa lta bu la/ nang stong pa'i lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa dang*/ smin mtshams thad rnams su me'i sa bon ram̐ yig bzhi dang bcas pa'i mes khengs bzhin la/ rlung bzung bas lte 'og nas dbu mar zhugs nas ram̐ yig bzhi la rlung chen phog pas rkyen byas/ dbu ma yar skyes tshangs bug tu thal gyi sleb/ ram̐ gong ma las ram̐ gcig 'phros/ me lce'i steng der phyin nas bsdad/ yang rlung bzung bas ram̐ de la rlung phog pas smin mtshams kyi stod cha'i thad man gyi dbu ma mes khengs/ mgo la bde drod tshad med pa skyes bar bsgom/ res 'ga' lus thams cad dbu mas khyab par bsgom pas rtsa gnas gang du rlung zin kyang yon tan skye ba'i gnad/ res 'ga' nam mkha'i gar khyab rtsa dbu mas khyab par bsgom pas snang sems 'dres pa'i rnam rtog skye ba'i gnad yod do/ de bzhin du spyi bo'i haṃ yig las bdud rtsi byang sems dkar po'i rgyun babs pas lus thams cad gang bar bsgom 816)pas/ bde nyams skye zhing tshad pa dang rlung nad zhi/ de bzhin du spyi bo'i haṃ yig gi bdud rtsi byang sems dkar po bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pas lus gang*/

ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad gang ste bde stong du me re bar bsgoms pas snang ba thams cad bde bar 'char/ lte ba'i a thung las me 'bar bas lus thams cad gang*/ ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched las nyon dang bcas pa sregs nas ye shes kyi lus su bsgoms pas/ sdig sgrib dag bde drod 'bar/ zas 'ju/ grang ba'i nad zhi/ me lce ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'bar te gnas mal dang yul phyogs khyab par 'bar bar bsgoms pas gdon 'bros/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs/ nam mkha' gar khyab tu 'bar te sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsregs par bsgoms pas bsod nams rgya chen po 'thob bo/ de ltar me dang byang sems phyir spros pa bsdus nas mthar lus kyi a haṃ la bstim par bya'o/ stang stabs bcu pa ni/ bum chen sbir la 'phags te langs// lag g.yas thal bzed g.yon sdigs 'dzub/ rkang g.yas sa la lan 817)gsum brdab// lag g.yon thal bzed g.yas sdigs 'dzub// gong bzhin rkang g.yon lan gsum brdab// 'bebs chen gcig dang 'bebs chung gsum// ha sprug dang sbrags rlung ro phyungs// dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro// slar yang rlung bzung brkyang 'bebs brgyab// lag g.yas rke dang g.yon phrag pa// sa la phog mnyam zin par bya// rkang g.yas rting pas sa gsum brdung*// brkyang 'bebs dang sbrags go rjes la// g.yon pas gsum brdung 'bebs chung gsum// ha sprug byas pas dug rigs 'joms// tsog pu lag gnyis mig bkabs la// rkang g.yas steng bzhag lan gsum rdeb// g.yon pa steng bzhag gong bzhin gsum// tsog 'bebs gcig dang 'bebs chung gsum// ha sprugs byas pas nyu le 'joms/ 818)/brkyang 'bebs lag gnyis rna ba bzung*// g.yon grang g.yas pa steng bzhag gsum// brkyang 'bebs go brjes g.yas phra gsum// 'bebs chung gsum dang ha sprug byas// rgab 'dre ngan pa 'joms byed pa'o// langs te bab bzhi sa la gtsugs// gdong pa g.yas phyogs 'bebs chung gcig

/slar la sa gang ltar bzhin g.yon phyogs// 'bebs chung bzhi dang rlung ro ni// ha sprug byas pas bse rag 'joms/ sdigs 'dzub g.yas dang pus g.yas bslangs// sdigs mdzub g.yon pa sa la gtad// rkang g.yas mthil gyi sa gsum brdung*// rkang lag go brjes g.yon pas gsum// 'bebs chung gsum dang ha sprug gis// klu bdud rigs rnams 'joms par 'gyur// phyed skyil lag bsnol ngar gdong bzung*/ khog stod g.yas gsum g.yon gsum yo// mchan brdab gcus 819)'bebs 'bebs chung gsum// ha sprug byas pas 'dre lha 'joms// 'bebs chung lag g.yas sna bzung zhing*// g.yon pas lag mkhrig bzung pa sprad// phyed skyil rkang 'phang lan gsum brdab// 'bebs chung lag rjes gong bzhin gsum// ha sprug byas pas gshin rje 'joms// langs la lag g.yon rked pa brten// g.yas pas sdigs mdzub nam mkhar khyer// rkang g.yas gsum brdab 'bebs chen brgyab// slar langs go brjes g.yon pas gsum// 'bebs chen cig dang 'bebs chung gsum// ha sprug byas pas ma mo 'joms// rkang lag g.yas gnyis g.yas su brkyangs// slar bskum g.yon brkyangs lan drug bya// 'bebs chung gsum dang ha sprug byas// ha sprug byas pas bdud dpung 'joms// bdud dpung 'joms pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro// de nas de la rlung phog pas// ram̐ las ram̐ ni ring po ched// sngon ma'i me yi steng 820)du phyin// de la'ang ni rlung phog pas// me ni shin tu cher 'bar te// dbu ma'i yar sner slebs par bsam/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rang nyid yi dam 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug sku dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu'i nang du/ rtsa dbu ma lte 'og nas tshangs bug gi bar du drang seng nge yod pa'i lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa dang smin 'tshams kyi thad dang spyi bo'i nang rnams su raṃ yig re re dang bcas pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyis mes gang bzhin la/

rlung bzung bas lte 'og nas dbu mar zhugs/ ram̐ yig rnams la phog pas/ ram̐ gong ma la ram̐ yig re re dang bcas pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyis mes gang bzhin la// rlung bzung bas lte 'og nas dbu mar zhugs// ram̐ yig rnams la phog pas/ ram̐ gong ma la ram̐ yig ring po gcig 'chad de sngon ma'i me'i steng du phyin/ yang rlung bzung bas de la'ang rlung phog pas me shin tu cher 'bar te/ dbu ma'i yar sne'i bar me sleb cing gang bar bsam/ de yang dge ba'i bsam pa dad pa dag snang la sogs pa nam skyes kyang*/ rang nyid lha sku rtsa dbu ma ram̐ yig dang bcas pa gsal ba'i ngang las/ rlung phyir bus pas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs las grub pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dpag tu med par gyur te/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 821)mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mchod pas rab tu mnyes par byas/ rlung tshur rngubs pa dang mnyam du de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad ngo bo bdud rtsi byang sems dkar dmar la rnam pa 'od dkar dmar gyi rnam par tshur bsdus lte ba'i me la bstim la rlung thub tshad mnan/ dad gus bskyed do/ de nas dge ba'i rtog pa thams cad longs sku dang bsre ba'o/ yang sems la 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa mi dge ba'i rtog pa nam skyes pa dang*/ rlung phyir bus pas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas/ chags pa dang sdang ba skye ba'i yul de la phog pas sdig sgrib dag nas lha'i skur gyur/ tshur rngubs pas kho'i tshe dang bsod nams kha rje dbang thang lus ngag yid gsum gyis bcud thams cad/ bdud rtsi byang sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bo la rnam pa 'od zer dkar dmar gyi rnam par bsdus la lte ba'i me la bstim la byams pa dang snying rje bsgom mo/ des ngan rtog sprul sku dang bsre ba zhes bya ste dbang bsdud kyi mchog tu 'gyur zhing sgrib pa gzhi med du 'gyur ro/

dge ba dang mi dge ba gang du yang lung ma 822)bstan pa'i rnam rtog breng breng 'gyu ba'i tshe/ rang lus yi dam dbu ma me dang bcas pa 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal ba'i ngang nas/ rlung rang babs su bzhag la gang shar gyi ngo bo de la bzo bcos med par bzhag ma yengs pa'i dran rdzi tsam las gtad so med par bzhag des lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa chos sku dang bsre ba zhes bya ste mchog gi gtum mo yin no/ de bzhin du dug lnga sbyang ba'i gtum mo ni/ rang lus 'jig rten dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ka ro za'i sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i nang dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i ram̐ yig de kha dog mthing ka yum nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ma'i ngo bor bsgom/ rlung bzung bas ram̐ la phog chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo me lce mthing ga 'khor lo'i dbyibs can me sgra bai ro tsa na'i sgra dang bcas pa 'bar/ lus gang*/ gti mug gi rten byed pa'i rtsa yig dang dud 'gror skye ba'i rtsa yig gti mug gi sgrib pa ma dag pa'i gzugs phung dang bcas pa bsregs/ chos dbyings ye shes bskyed pa'i rtsa yig thams cad kyi nus pa bskyed/ gzugs phung rnam snang gi ngo bo dang dbyer med par 823)byas/ me lce phyir nam mkha' khyab par 'bar/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bsregs/ snod kyi 'jig rten stug po bkod dang bcud kyi sems can rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang la bkod par gyur/ rkang ba bsnol ma sems skyil la/ lag gnyis bsnol te g.yas steng nas/ btang la pus mo gnyis la 'ju/ lus srong*/ rlung khug gcig la dmigs pa gsal bar bya/ de nas lus thams cad shigs se glod la g.yas chos skor gsum/ g.yon bon skor gsum/ lus gcus g.yas gsum g.yon gsum bya/ 'bebs chung gsum brgyab po/ me tshur 'dus lte 'og gi ram̐ la thim par bsgom/ de bzhin du lte bar yum mā ma ki'i ngo bo ram̐ dkar gsal las me long ye shes kyi me lce dkar po rdo rje'i dbyibs can ak+ṣo bhe'i sgra dang bcas sbar bas/

zhe sdang dang dmyal ba'i rtsa yig bsregs nas me long ye shes bskyed/ rnam shes phung po bsregs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 824)ngo bor byas/ me phyir 'bar bas sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang gi rgyu 'bras dang dmyal ba bsregs nas mngon par dga' ba dang rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rkang gnyis mthil sprad khru gang langs la lag gnyis mthil sbyar spyi bo mtho gang sor brkyangs/ lus rdo rje ltar bsrangs la rlung khug gcig la dmigs pa gsal nas/ pho ba g.yas gsum g.yon gsum bskor/ bar 'bebs gcig dang 'bebs chung gsum brgyab po/ me tshur 'dus lte 'og gi ram̐ la thim par bsgom/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngo bo ram̐ ser po gser mdog lta bu las/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi mi gser mdog rin po che'i dbyibs su rat+na saṃ bha'i sgra dang bcas sbar bas/ nga rgyal dang lha mi'i rtsa yig sregs nas mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed/ tshor phung bsregs nas rin 'byung gi ngo bor byas/ phyir 'bar bas sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal dang*/ pham ltung skye rga na 'chi'i rgyu 'bras bsregs/ dpal ldan zhing dang rin 'byung gi go 'phang la bzhag par gyur/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung lag gnyis snying gar 625)thal sbyar gru mo gdengs/ lus bsrang*/ rlung khug gcig la dmigs pa gsal nas/ lag gtsugs skyil krung lan gsum brdab/ 'bebs chung gsum brgyab po/ me tshur 'dus lte ba'i raṃ la thim par bsgom/ yum gos dkar mo'i ngo bo/ ram̐ yig pad+ma rā ga lta bu las sor rtogs ye shes kyi me pad+ma'i dbyibs pad+ma dha ra'i sgra dang bcas te sbar bas/ 'dod chags dang yi dwags kyi rtsa yig sregs/ sor rtogs ye shes bskyed/ 'du shes snang mtha'i ngo bor bsgyur/ phyir 'bar bas sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang yi dwags kyi rgyu 'bras bsregs nas/ bde ba can dang snang mtha'i go 'phang la bkod par gyur/

rkang pa phyed skyil lag gnyis thal mos pus mo'i lhang bkab/ lus bsrang rlung khug gcig la dmigs pa gsal nas/ lus glod pa'i ngang nas 'bebs chung gsum brgyab po/ me tshur 'dus lte 826)'og gi ram̐ la thim par bsgom/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma'i ngo bo ram̐ ljang gu iṇ+ḍa ni la lta bu la/ bya grub ye shes kyi me ljang gu ral gri'i dbyibs a mo gha sid+dhi'i sgra dang bcas te 'bar bas/ lha min dang phrag dog gi rtsa yig las sgrib dang bcas pa bsregs nas/ bya grub ye shes bskyed pa'i rtsa rlung thig le thams cad kyi nus pa gsal bar byas pas/ don yod grub pa'i ngo bor byas nas/ phyir 'bar bas sems can gyi phrag dog dang lha ma yin gyi rgyu 'bras sdug bsngal dang bcas pa bsregs nas/ las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing dang don yod grub pa'i go 'phang la bzhag par gyur/ lus shed kyi ldang*/ rkang gshibs mtshams mi mngon par byas la lag gnyis sor bsnol gung mo dang mdzub mo bsgrengs la gshibs nas shad kyi brkyangs/ lus ma yo bar legs par bsrang*/ rlung khug gcig la dmigs pa gsal nas/ lus hril gyi bsgrim nas 'bebs chen gcig dang 'bebs chung gsum brgyab po/ mthar me rnams gzhi'i gtum mo lte ba'i ram̐ yig la bsdu'o/ bdag nyid mthong thos dran 827)reg gi dug lnga dang rigs drug gi sdug bsngal zhi nus pa dang*/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas pa'i zhing du dug lnga dang rigs drug gis sdug bsngal med par gyur cig rang gi sna bug nas rlung phar rgyu ba'i tshe/ rang gi bsod nams dang dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa de thams cad sems can thams cad la sib kyi thim pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba tshad med pa dang ldan par bsgoms/ rang gi sna bug nas rlung tshur rngub pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad gcig kyang ma lus par rang la sib kyi thim pas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar bsgom mo/

yang lus khol bur drang na/ lag gnyis mchan brdab brkyang*/ lag 'thil 'phur bas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis brdabs pas me lhab lhab 'bar bar bsgom/ gar drang ba'i sar grangs mang du 'phur/ mchan brdabs yang yang bya'o/ lus nam drang du mchan brdabs bya'o/ chos thun bdun pa'o/ zhag gsum bya/ dmigs thun bdun pa ni/ me thabs drug chings byas la/ de nas de la rlung phog pas: de las ram̐ gnyis chad nas ni: dbu ma'i phy-i yi bar du phyin: de gnyis las ni 828)me rab 'bar: dbu ma'i phyi dang byang khog bar: thams cad me yi rab tu khengs: zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ rang lus khro bo'i sku dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu la/ nang stong sang nge ba'i lte 'og nas spyi bo'i bar du dbu ma lcags sbubs mes gang ba lta bu'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang la/ rlung bzung bas lte 'og nas dbu mar song nas ram̐ yig rnams la rlung phog pas/ ram̐ yig steng ma de'i dra g.yas ngos kyi lag ge las ram̐ gnyis chad nas ni/ dbu ma'i phyi sku lus kyi nang g.yas g.yon gnyis su phyir song ste/ de yang me'i thag pas dang po'i me dang 'brel bar bsgoms te/ de gnyis las ni ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas/ dbu ma'i phyi dag byang khog bar te/ spyi bo nas rkang pa'i sen rtse yan chad thams cad mes rab tu khengs pas/ lus kyi ma dang pa'i phung po khams dag skye mched rtsa rlung thig le thams cad bsregs nas ye shes kyi lus khro bo'i sku dngos su gyur pa'i nang thams cad me'i rang bzhin dmar lhang nge*/ dper na rdza ma mes rab tu bsregs pa'i nang lta bu dang*/ de yang stong pa ma yin pa me lces gang bar bsgom/ lus po'i stod 829)smad gang du na ba'i sar bug pa cung zad yod par bsgom la/ de nas me lce dmar 'u ru ru phar 'gro bar dmigs pas nad gang yang phan pa dang*/ lus stod smad gang du grang ba dang 'khyags pa'i sar de rang du dmigs gtad la me 'u ru ru 'bar bar bsgom pas drod skye ba dang*/

'khrul 'khor yang pho skor g.yas g.yon drug gi tshe lto ba dang sked pa mes gang ba la rig pa gtad/ khu tshur zhags 'phen dus lag pa'i nang sor rtse bar dmar 'ur 'ur/ rkang lag ( 'phra dus ? )kyang de ltar dang*/ lus 'phur sprug dus ba spu'i khung nas kyang dmar nyug nyug pa dang*/ rlung btang ba'i tshe 'jig rten thams cad mes khengs nas gnod byed thams cad bsregs pa'am bskrad/ tshur rngubs pas lte ba'am lus kyi me la bsdu'o/ dmigs pa gsal nas pus mo g.yas la 'jus nas g.yas g.yon du pho ba lan gsum g.yon la 'jus nas gsum gsum bskor/ de tshe rlung drag tu bzung thub tshad bzung nas/ mthar rta rgod sprugs pa ltar drag tu sprugs nas 'bebs chung cig bya/ de 'dra gsum gyi mthar 'bebs chen gcig 830)gam 'bebs chung gsum bya/ rkang lag gi mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bsgom la kha sbyar ba'am/ lus 'phur bas me lhab lhab 'bar bar bsgom/ des kyang drod che ma nus na: rtsa chen rtsa 'bring rtsa bran kun: thams cad ram̐ ni rgya grog tsam: grog tshang rlog bzhin gyur par bsam: ram̐ ni re re'i 'od zer tshad: nyi ma'i 'od zer tsam pa bsam: zhes pa'i don ni/ bogs 'don la/ lus kyi rtsa grangs med yod pa thams cad yi ge ram̐ yig dmar po sha stag tu gyur te/ dper na rgya grog gi tshang slog pa lta bu la ram̐ yig re re'i 'od zer dang tsha ngar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'od tsam du bsgom la/ rlung bzung bas ram̐ yig de thams cad las me 'bar bas lus thams cad me'i ngo bo dmar wa ler bsgom/ nyi shu pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ rlung bzung 'phur sub tshar gcig rjes// rkang pa mthil spyad pa shang bar gtems// rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol// sbrul tshang 'ub tang hing ring gis// drag tu ( drong ? ) bgrang zhing phyir 'dzin bya// bar 'bebs 831)gcig brgyab rkang mthil sprad// cung langs rdo rje khu tshur bsrang*// phyir 'dzin dpung mgo lan gsum gteg

/bar 'bebs gcig brgyab 'phags te langs// bsgur la lag bsnol lag rgyab sprad// rkang mtheb gnyis bcangs phyir 'dzin dang*// g.yas g.yon gsum gcu bar 'bebs brgyab// phyed skyil lag g.yon pus gong bkan// g.yas pa sta zur g.yas ngos bshad// nam mkhar thal mo lan gsum bkan// g.yon pa la'ang de bzhin te// 'bebs chung gsum brgyab ha sprug bya// phyed skyil lag gnyis sa non byas// dpung g.yas dal 'then lan gsum bcag /g.yon gsum mnyam por mdun du gsum// rgyab gsum mgo bo g.yas gsum bcag /g.yon gsum mdun gsum rgyab tu gsum// g.yas bskor 832)gsum dang g.yon skor gsum// thal mo sor bsnol phyi nang ldog /rlung 'bud dang basbrags phar la brgyangs// gsum gcu rngubs tshe brang la brdab// lan gsum byas rjes khu tshur gnyis// rang rang thad kyi nu steng mnan// g.yas gsum g.yon gsum dal bus gcu// gzhu 'gengs g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bya// rdo rje khu tshur mdun rgyab gnyis// g.yas gsum g.yon gsum res mos gcu// lag pas sa non dpung pa g.yas// g.yas gsum g.yon gsum drug tu bskor// de bzhin g.yon pa'ang drug bskor te// lhan cig drug bskor ha sprug bya// sa non rgya mtsho g.yas g.yon du// drug bskor g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab bcag /sa gnon byas la pus mo g.yas// g.yas g.yon drug bskor g.yon pa'ang drug /'bebs chung gcig brgyab ha sprugs byas// rje rje skyil dkrung sa non byas// rgya mtsho g.yas gsum g.yon gsum bskor// lag btsugs skyil krung lan gsum rdeg 833)/'bebs chung gsum brgyab ha sprugs bya// sgo bzhi sor bsdams g.yas bskor gsum/ g.yon bskor gsum dang sang sang gsum// g.yas g.yon dbus su lus sprug dgu// gcus gsum sprug gsum rjes ma dang*/ lhan cig ha bton rnam rol lo// 'phags langs lus bsgur rkang mtheb bcangs// rkang pa yar 'then gan rkyal 'dril// rkang mthil sar rdeb slar yang langs// lan gsum byas rjes 'bebs chen brgyab// skyil krung rang thad ro rkyang ni// rlung khug gcig la mtheb mos mnan// 'phags langs lag g.yas mdun gsum sprugs// g.yon gsum rkang g.yas mdun du gsum// rkang g.yon gsum sprugs 'bebs chen brgyab// ha gsum bton la slar yang langs// lag sor rgyab brkyangs lus po dgye// sar reg lag gnyis mdun du brkyangs// dgu zhing sar reg dgye dgu drug

834)/'bebs chen gcig brgyab lag rked 'khyud// 'bebs chung dang sbrags rkang g.yas brkyangs// lan gsum 'phong brdab 'bebs chung lhan// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang g.yon gsum 'phra// mnyam por gsum 'phra 'bebs chung gsum// 'phags las gong bzhin g.yas gsum brdabs// slar yang rgyab brkyangs lan gsum brdab// de bzhin g.yon pa'ang mdun rgyab drug /'bebs chen gcig dang 'bebs chung rgyab// ha sprug g.yas g.yon mdun sprug dgu /de rjes dmigs med ngang du bzhag chos thun brgyad pa'o/ zhag gsum mo/ gnyis pa sher dbang gi lam thig le'i rdzogs rim dmigs thun brgyad pa ni/ lus gnad tsog pu pus 'khyud sgom thag bcas pas/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas: dbu ma ring thung mdzub gang tsam: sna rtse'i bar du yod bsam: de nas tshangs pa'i bu ga ru: 'khor lo rtsibs drug mu khyud dang: de rgyab pad 'dab bcu drug bsam: sna rtse'i thad nas dbu ma'i sne: me lcai nyer gsum gyis bsgags bsam: 'dab ma 835)'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams ni: nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa yi: re re nas kyang thig le ni: nyi shu rtsa gnyis phyir la bab: dbu ma mgrin pa'i thad du sleb: de la'ang me lces bsgags par bsam: sna rtse'i me lce'i steng du ni: thig le bcu gcig bsdad nas ni: bcu gcig mgrin par babs par bsam: mgrin pa nas ni mchan zhabs thad: dbu ma phyir ring me lces bsgags: mgrin pa'i me lce'i steng du ni: thig le drug bsdad lnga phyir babs: mchan zhabs thad du sleb par bsam: de nas dbu ma phyir ring nas: lte ba'i gnya' ru slebs par bsam: de yi 'tshams nas me yi bsgags: thig le gsum ni snying khar bsdad: thig le gnyis ni phyir la babs: yang ni dbu ma phyir la ring: lte ba'i phyir 'og de ru ste: de yi 'tshams nas me yi bsgags: zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rang lus he ru ka dmar gsal dar gur lta bu'i spyi bo'i nang der 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs drug pa'i lte ba dang rtsibs la thig le re re/
